## Quotes and dashes {#quotes}

She said "hello" -- then 'left' --- quickly... It's fine.

## Soft breaks {#breaks}

A paragraph that the author wrapped
across several lines in the source,
like most hand-written markdown.

## Escapes {#escapes}

Use snake_case names, 5 \* 3, a literal \# hash, and price \$5.

## Footnotes and refs {#refs}

A claim with a footnote.[^1] See @fig-none and [@knuth1984].

[^1]: The footnote text.

## Emoji and entities {#emoji}

Fish & chips < 5 > 3, and an em—dash typed directly.
